tools.name: search_symbols
tools.description: Search tradable symbols in one of DataQuant's six markets (ashare=A-shares, usstock=US stocks, hkstock=HK stocks, crypto, indices, etfs) by code or name keyword. Returns matching symbol codes. Market data only; no investment advice is provided.

tools.name: get_klines
tools.description: Get historical daily kline rows (open, high, low, close, volume, amount, adj_factor) for one symbol in a DataQuant market, between start and end dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns published market data rows; data may be delayed and is not investment advice.

tools.name: get_macro_overview
tools.description: List global macroeconomic indicator data published by DataQuant, covering regions such as US, China, euro area, Japan and others. Returns indicator rows as published; no analysis or advice is added.
